title: Cobblemon: Curvier Pokemon (Mega Showdown Support)
description: A resource pack that gives lopunny, gardevior, and delphox curves, that's pretty much it
body:
If you're seeing this then the moderation team had no problem with this, or you're the moderation team, regardless...

You saw the pack's icon, you saw the pack's name, you know what you're getting into, if y'all like it I might expand it to other pokemon.

Also supports mega lopunny from mega showdown.
